step.action: Match the arriving person's name and face to 📦 Camp_Member_Roster.
step.ifThen: IF the person does not match the roster, THEN pause the arrival and ask the Dominatrix.

step.action: Mark the person's arrival on 📦 Camp_Member_Roster.
Give the person one wristband from 📦 Camp_Wristbands.
Give the person one necklace from 📦 Camp_Necklaces when the current arrival plan calls for one.
Show the person the kitchen, drinking water, shower, toilets, common area, and Dominatrix station.
Show the person their tent or sleeping location on 📦 Camp_Map.
Show the person the parking area, service lanes, and emergency exits on 📦 Camp_Map.
Tell the person not to park or leave belongings in a service lane or emergency exit.

passWhen.criterion: The person's roster entry shows arrival.
The person has the required camp identifier.
The person can locate camp services, their sleeping location, parking, service lanes, and emergency exits.
